name: wakeflow
description: Unattended control loops for multi-window agent work.

interface.shortDescription: Unattended control loops for agent work
interface.longDescription: Wakeflow helps a controller coordinate multi-window agent work with local state roots, task packages, compact delivery intents, target result envelopes, and evidence-first review. It prepares unattended workflows without secretly sending prompts or replacing controller judgment.
defaultPrompt: Set up a Wakeflow control loop
